title: Delivery Driver Jobs in Inzeron Trading & Contracting - Aluva, Kerala
description:
**Job Requirements**
 Job Title: Delivery Driver Jobs in Inzeron Trading \& Contracting \- Aluva, Kerala
   

  

 Company Name: Inzeron Trading \& Contracting
   

  

 Location: Aluva, Kerala, India
   

  

 Salary: Rs. 18,000 \- 20,000 per Month
   

  

 Qualification: 10th Pass and above
   

  

 Experience: 1\-2 years in Courier Delivery Job
   

  

**Job Description**
 Join Inzeron Trading \& Contracting as a Delivery Driver in Aluva, Kerala! We are actively seeking dedicated individuals for courier delivery jobs within our team. This position is perfect for those who are motivated, enjoy working independently, and wish to make a positive impact by delivering goods to our valued customers.
   

  

 As a Delivery Driver with Inzeron Trading \& Contracting, you will be responsible for transporting packages safely and efficiently. Your role is vital in ensuring timely deliveries and maintaining customer satisfaction. If you are ready to contribute to a growing company and make a difference, we want to hear from you!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Safely pick up and deliver packages from various locations for Inzeron Trading \& Contracting.
* Maintain accurate records of all deliveries and ensure all packages are accounted for.
* Communicate effectively with customers regarding delivery times and any changes.
* Adhere to traffic laws and safety regulations while driving to ensure a safe delivery process.
* Ensure the delivery vehicle is kept clean and well\-maintained.
* Handle any customer inquiries or complaints professionally.
* Optimize delivery routes for maximum efficiency.
* Report any vehicle issues or delivery problems to the management team.
* Provide exceptional customer service and support at all times for Inzeron Trading \& Contracting.
* Follow company policies and operational procedures established by Inzeron Trading \& Contracting.


**Requirements**
* Minimum qualification of 10th pass and above.
* At least 1\-2 years of experience in courier delivery.
* Valid Aadhar Card and PAN Card.
* A valid Driving License and access to a reliable vehicle.
* Strong communication skills in English and local languages.
* Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
* Attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary ranging from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 20,000 per month at Inzeron Trading \& Contracting.
* Opportunities for career growth and advancement within the company.
* Supportive work environment with a friendly team at Inzeron Trading \& Contracting.
* Flexible working hours to fit your schedule.


 If you are looking for an exciting opportunity in courier delivery with Inzeron Trading \& Contracting, Spply Now!
